Elena — thanks, will do. Initial notes below and I attached a brief pricing matrix (audit_log_pricing_matrix.xlsx) plus a draft SOW for the residency work. Quick summary up front:

- Audit logs: monthly per-GB retention tiers with steep discounts above 1TB/month; separate archival price for >5y cold storage.
- KMS: Redwood-managed KMS (key tenancy in EU) is an incremental monthly fee + per-key rotation API calls pricing. No import/export restrictions.
- HSM (customer-managed): supports FIPS 140-2 Level 3 HSMs; one-time on-boarding engineering fee, plus monthly bridge/agent fee; legal review required for key escrow text.

Attachments: audit_log_pricing_matrix.xlsx, WellNest_SOW_v2.pdf

Elena, Olga — quick technical breakdown from infra: 

If WellNest provides an on-prem HSM, our integration effort is larger (networking, proxy, compliance checks). Estimate: 5-7 engineering days (one-time) + 0.75 FTE for the first month for runbooks and verification. 

Cloud HSM (dedicated tenant) is much faster: 2-3 days and a smaller monthly connector fee. Both options support EU residency for keys. Note: on-prem HSM requires a physical change control appendix and we will ask for limited remote access for validation — this is usually the procurement hold-up.

I’ve attached a short doc with the technical route options (redwood-kms-hsm-terms.docx). I’ll put numbers in the audit_log_pricing_matrix.xlsx for both on-prem and cloud-HSM flavors.
